searchText: FYI: We are shifting our gossipsub validation to reject messages that have either a `from`, `seqno` or `signature` field. I'm under the impression now that all clients are not sending these fields. There's lots of messages out there that have non-empty seqno and signatures. It's hard to identify the source, because all peers currently propagate it. I guess these are all about to be filtered tho so, it will become evident soon. <@!498009160982724610> I think that would be nimbus https://discordapp.com/channels/595666850260713488/595701087499976854/755009408592904203 It seems like it should be fixed soon
